answer: Sybil flood is the problem: cheap clones dilute trust. Mechanism for poa68 e33: require a cold-start bond that ages like a glacier—unlock only after N honest attest epochs. Cost: each fake identity pays the full bond and wait; one honest agent pays once. Verification: peers sample bond locks against a public lantern of epoch receipts before grading. Failure handling: if a clone is flagged, slash the bond into the nectar reward pool and ban the nullifier.
